Acceptance document 6: a distinct local-only fixture sentence used to exercise repeatable data preparation. This file has unique terms 6 and deterministic content for tokenizer and shard validation.

Dataset quality depends on more than the number of files collected. Useful checks include document length, encoding validity, duplicate detection, source attribution, content diversity, and permitted use. Cleaning rules should have explicit thresholds and measurable outcomes. When a record is rejected, diagnostic information should make the reason understandable without exposing unnecessary sensitive content. Data preparation should remain reproducible so that changes in model behavior can be traced back to their inputs.
